أستكر (form X)
# أَسْتَكْرِ (ʔastakri) /ʔas.tak.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
# أُسْتَكْرَ (ʔustakra) /ʔus.tak.ra/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
